No bugs found — bug fix is complete and verified.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:632-640 — Font-registration guard uses `if 'DejaVuSans' not in pdfmetrics.getRegisteredFontNames()`. Correct and idempotent; the 3-hit test confirms no re-registration errors.

server.py:646 — datetime strftime uses '%-d' and '%-I' which are GNU/Linux-specific format specifiers; would raise on Windows/macOS but fine in the Kubernetes/Linux deployment (already flagged in iteration_13).

server.py:654-656 — `cell_bold_white` correctly overrides textColor=colors.white so Paragraph-level colour matches the TableStyle TEXTCOLOR=white for the header row. This is the actual fix for the black-on-green readability bug.
server.py:680, 691 — Currency uses explicit '\u20B9' unicode escape rather than the literal '₹'. Byte-identical but clearer intent; consistent between distributor earnings and agent wallet columns.
server.py at 2720 lines remains the primary code-review concern (>700-line threshold). PDF renderer (~145 lines) could be extracted to modules/exports_pdf.py alongside the future backup extraction.
